title: Map of Evolution — tree file
description: A list of lineages (nodes). Every file in data/tree/ is merged into one tree.

scientific.description: Scientific name, if different from name.

parent.description: Id of the lineage this one branched from. null only for the root.

hybridOf.description: Extra ancestors: hybrids or endosymbiosis. Drawn as dashed gold links.

appeared.description: Origin, in millions of years ago. 0.01 = 10,000 years ago.

extinct.description: Extinction, in millions of years ago. Omit if still alive.

tags.description: e.g. landmark, fruit, vegetable, crop, dinosaur, domesticated, ocean, flight, living-fossil

origin.description: How humans shaped a domesticated lineage.

image.description: What to show as the picture: an English Wikipedia article title whose lead photo best shows what this looks like (e.g. a famous member of a clade), or a full https:// image URL. Defaults to the wiki article's own photo.

medicine.description: For germs that make people sick. Shown as the "In medicine" section of the card. Educational, not clinical guidance.

from.description: Id of the organism the drug (or the natural compound it is made from) comes from, e.g. "streptomyces".

us.description: Where it turns up in the United States.

states.description: Two-letter postal codes of the states where it is most common (DC allowed).

nationwide.description: True when it occurs across the whole country; states then marks the hot spots.

resistance.description: One or two sentences on drug resistance.
